newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stocks close mixed as market stirs.
newsitem.headline: Lima stocks close mixed as market stirs.

text.p: The Lima Stock Exchange closed mixed on Wednesday. The market stirred from its recent lethargy to register gains by some leaders but an overall fall, brokers said.
They predicted corrections among leaders on Thursday but increases for second- and third-tier shares.
On Wednesday, the General Index edged down 0.17 percent to 1,562.81 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index gained 0.64 percent to 2,106.6.
Total market volume was an improved but still a moderate 32.7 million soles ($12.9 million) on 1,523 trades as overall 21 stocks rose, 24 rose and 32 were flat.
"Some leading stocks rose today due to cheap prices caused by corrections after speculative rises," said Manuel Torres, of Finvest brokerage.

Among blue-chips, benchmark Telefonica del Peru rose 1.04 percent to 5.83 soles on 3.4 million shares or 61 percent of total market volume, while miner Minsur gained 1.96 percent to 23.45 soles on 4,459 shares.

Breweries Compania Nacional de Cerveza (CNC) and Backus y Johnston continued to benefit from rumors of a merger, with CNC up 2.96 percent to 1.39 soles on 478,017 shares and Backus gaining 1.84 percent to 2.77 soles on 176,208 shares.
Brokers said there was high expectation on the market ahead of next week's second quarter results, with Telefonica and Banco de Credito both expected to register impressive balances.
